text: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi: Farmers get Rs 6000 per year in 3 installments of Rs 2000 each via DBT.
Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY): Provides health cover of Rs 5 Lakh per family per year for hospitalization.
PM Awas Yojana (PMAY): Providing 'Housing for All' to urban and rural poor with financial assistance.
PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY): Financial benefit of Rs. 5,000/- provided to pregnant mothers.
Atal Pension Yojana (APY): Monthly pension between Rs 1000-5000 for unorganized sector workers.
Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY): High-interest savings scheme for the girl child with tax benefits.
PM Mudra Yojana: Loans up to 10 lakh for small enterprises without security.
Ujjwala Yojana: Free LPG connection and stove for women from BPL households.
MGNREGA: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to rural households.
PM Vishwakarma: Support for traditional artisans with toolkits (15k) and low-interest loans (3L).
Jan Dhan Yojana: Basic savings account with zero balance, insurance, and overdraft facility.
PM SVANidhi: Micro-credit facility for street vendors to access collateral-free loans up to Rs 50,000.
Stand-Up India: Bank loans (10L-1Cr) for at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower per branch.
PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY): Accidental death/disability cover of 2L for Rs 20/year.
PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY): Life insurance cover of 2L for Rs 436/year.
PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan: Contributory pension scheme for unorganized workers with Rs 3000 monthly pension.
PM Vaya Vandana Yojana: Pension scheme for seniors (60+) with 7.4% assured returns.
One Nation One Ration Card: Allows beneficiaries to lift foodgrains from any FPS in India via Aadhaar.
Digital India (CSC): Common Service Centers provide G2C services like Aadhaar and PAN.
Skill India (PMKVY): Short-term training/certification for youth with financial rewards.
PM Poshan (Mid-Day Meal): Ensures nutritional food for all school-going children in gov schools.
Jal Jeevan Mission: Target to provide Har Ghar Jal (piped water) to every rural household.
Mission Indradhanush: Immunization coverage for pregnant women and children against diseases.
PM-GKAY: Free 5kg food grains per person per month to NFSA beneficiaries.
PMAY-Gramin: Interest subvention and financial help for rural housing construction.
Kisan Credit Card (KCC): Provides timely credit to farmers for seasonal agriculture.
PM SVANidhi Part 2: Working capital loan 2nd tranche (20k) and 3rd tranche (50k) eligibility.
Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana: Supporting holistic development of agriculture sectors.
PM-CARES for Children: Support for children orphaned by COVID-19 pandemic.
Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB): Government securities denominated in grams of gold.
Gruha Lakshmi (Karnataka): Monthly financial assistance of Rs 2,000 to the woman head of house.
Shakti Scheme (Karnataka): Free bus travel facility for women and students.
Anna Bhagya (Karnataka): 10 kg of free food grains for BPL and Antyodaya cardholders.
Rythu Bharosa (AP): Financial assistance of Rs 13,500 per year to farmers in Andhra Pradesh.
Pudhumai Penn (Tamil Nadu): Rs 1,000 monthly scholarship for gov school girls joining college.
Magalir Urimai Thogai (Tamil Nadu): Financial help of Rs 1,000 per month for women heads.
Swachh Bharat (Gramin): Financial incentive of Rs 12,000 provided for toilet construction.
Deendayal Antyodaya (NRLM): Organizing rural poor into self-help groups for livelihoods.
